// 1. Hook the loadData so it gives you max currency whenever loaded
if (window.ytgame && window.ytgame.game) {
  const originalLoad = window.ytgame.game.loadData;
  window.ytgame.game.loadData = async function() {
    let raw = originalLoad ? await originalLoad() : null;
    let data = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
    
    // Set arbitrary huge coins (BigInteger supports any length string)
    data.currentCoinsAmount = "999999999999999999999999";
    data.incomeLevel = 100;
    data.slingshotLevel = 100;
    data.engineLevel = 100;
    
    console.log("[INJECTOR] Injected Currency:", data.currentCoinsAmount);
    return JSON.stringify(data);
  };

  // 2. Or force an instant cloud save right now:
  window.ytgame.game.saveData(JSON.stringify({
    currentCoinsAmount: "999999999999999999999999",
    currentLevelIndex: 0,
    currentLevelCounter: 0,
    incomeLevel: 100,
    slingshotLevel: 100,
    engineLevel: 100,
    secondsSpentUsingJoystick: 0.0,
    shownJoystickHandGestureCounter: 0,
    levelDatasList: [],
    boughtWorkshopUpgradeIdsList: []
  })).then(() => {
    console.log("[INJECTOR] Cloud save updated! Reload the page to see the new currency.");
  });
}
